subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad field report open as the routing umbrella, or split/link the remaining slices to narrower canonical issues and retire it?
rationale: Current main proves partial fixes but not a single terminal implementation; deciding whether the umbrella remains useful is a maintainer workflow and product-scope choice across several owner surfaces.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link the strongest remaining slices to owner-scoped issues, open any missing focused follow-ups with current-main evidence, and then close this broad tracker.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed, rejected, or moved, accepting that it remains hard to validate automatically.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close this issue now with links to existing narrower follow-ups, accepting that weaker slices should be re-filed if they recur with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link the strongest remaining slices to owner-scoped issues, open any missing focused follow-ups with current-main evidence, and then close this broad tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface routing and product-scope choice, and this handle has recent history across cron, Discord, docs, and broader issue-routing context.
